打开视频或将文件拖到这里: Open a video or drop a file here
拖入视频即可打开: Drop a video to open it
输入秒数或 HH:MM:SS，按 Enter 跳转: Enter seconds or HH:MM:SS, then press Enter
局部精调 · 滚轮缩放 · 拖动青色窗口平移: Fine adjustment · wheel to zoom · drag to move
可输入自定义时长；上下键每次调整 0.5 秒: Custom duration; arrow keys adjust by 0.5 s
↑ / ↓ 切换片段 · 双击循环预览\nCtrl / Shift 多选，每段导:
↑ / ↓ switch clips · double-click to loop
Ctrl / Shift to select multiple; one GIF per clip
留空时保存在视频旁的 FramePick 文件夹: Leave empty to save in a FramePick folder next to the video
打开视频，移动 5 秒窗口，按 A 收集片段。: Open a video, move the 5-second window, press A to collect.
请先完成或取消正在运行的任务。: Finish or cancel the running task first.
当前工程尚未保存。是否先保存？: There are unsaved changes. Save them first?
工程中的片段超出当前视频时长；请选择原始视频。: A clip extends beyond this video. Choose the original source.
已打开。点击时间轴定位，拖动窗口选取，按 A 收集。: Ready. Click the timeline, drag the window, press A to collect.
这一范围已经在列表中。: This range is already in the list.
请选择一个片段，再用当前窗口更新它。: Select one clip to replace with the current window.
请先选中片段，或使用“全部导出”。: Select clips first, or use Export all.
。日志保存在输出目录。: . Log saved in the output folder.
正在取消；已完成的 GIF 会保留。: Cancelling; completed GIFs will be kept.
本次还没有导出日志。: No export log in this session.
尚未找到工具。开发版可选择外部工具目录。: Tools not found. Source builds can use an external tools folder.
\n\n便携版默认使用包内固定版本，无需安装或配置 PATH。: Portable builds use embedded, pinned tools. No installation or PATH setup needed.
Space 播放 / 暂停\nA 收集当前窗口\nS 保存当前:
Space    Play / pause
A    Collect current window
S    Save snapshot
L    Loop current window
M    Mute / unmute
↑ / ↓    Previous / next clip
← / →    Seek 1 second
Shift + ← / →    Seek 10 seconds
[ / ]    Move window 0.1 second
, / .    Step by nominal frame rate
Ctrl+O    Open video
Ctrl+S    Save project
Ctrl+Shift+O    Open project

Click to seek; drag the window to move it. Wheel to zoom; hold at an edge to scroll.
退出会取消尚未完成的导出和截图。: Quitting will cancel unfinished exports and snapshots.
正在结束后台任务，请稍后关闭。: Stopping background tasks. Please close again shortly.
正在读取元数据，请稍后关闭。: Reading metadata. Please close again shortly.
点击定位；拖动青色窗口整体平移。局部时间轴可用滚轮缩放。: Click to seek; drag the window to move it. Wheel to zoom. Hold at an edge to scroll.
打开视频后开始选取: Open a video to start picking clips
未找到 FFmpeg / ffprobe。请在工具设置中选择它们所在的目录。: FFmpeg / ffprobe not found. Choose their folder in Tools settings.
文件没有可用的视频轨道。: This file has no usable video track.
无法确定视频时长或帧率。: Could not determine video duration or frame rate.
视频时长无效；暂不支持直播流。: Invalid video duration; live streams are not supported.
FFmpeg 超时；可重试该片段。详细信息见导出日志。: FFmpeg timed out. Retry the clip; details are in the export log.
输出文件重名过多，请选择其他文件夹。: Too many filename conflicts. Choose another folder.
选中范围没有可解码的画面，未生成调色板。: No decodable frames in the selected range; no palette generated.
该位置没有可截取的画面。: No frame available at this position.
时间必须是非负数。: Time must be a finite non-negative number.
分、秒须小于 60。: Minutes and seconds must be less than 60.
视频和选取窗口的时长必须大于 0。: Video and selection durations must be positive.
片段时间必须为整数毫秒。: Clip times must be integer milliseconds.
片段起点须非负，时长须在 0.1 秒至 1 小时之间。: Clips must start at or after zero and last 0.1 s to 1 hour.
GIF 长边须在 64–1920 像素之间。: GIF size must be between 64 and 1920 pixels.
GIF 帧率须在 1–50 FPS 之间。: GIF frame rate must be between 1 and 50 FPS.
打开或拖入视频即可开始，无需导入整个文件。: Open or drop a video. No full-file import needed.
1. 移动时间窗口，按 A 收集精彩片段。: 1. Move the time window; press A to collect.
2. 按 L 预览；按 S 保存截图。: 2. Press L to preview; S to save a snapshot.
3. 一次导出多个独立 GIF，原视频保持不变。: 3. Export separate GIFs in one batch. Your video stays unchanged.
还没有片段。在视频中选好范围，按 A 添加。: No clips yet. Choose a range and press A.
